title: Checkpoint restoration tests do not distinguish core success from all-cases success
reasoning: The successful scenarios pass every populated group, and the failure scenario fails a core test. Consequently, an implementation that computes checkpoints_passed using only core results would satisfy these assertions. The stated requirement that passed checkpoints include functionality and regression results is therefore unprotected, allowing restored benchmark results to overstate strict checkpoints solved.
recommendation: Expand the existing checkpoint restoration scenarios to cover all core tests passing while functionality or regression tests fail. Assert that strict checkpoints_passed remains zero while checkpoints_core_solved remains one.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No included scenario separates core success from functionality or regression failure; regression totals are zero throughout.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parameterize the existing restoration coverage across functionality and regression failures with fully passing core tests, checking strict passed counts separately from core-solved counts.
